rows.notes: The study is a systematic literature review (SLR) of 214 articles on UAV imagery in agriculture (Sections 1-3, Table 1, Table 6). It reports no own experiment, field data, survey or validated model run; it synthesises published work on crop classification, disease detection, yield estimation and process monitoring (Section 4.5). Its statements on pest/disease detection and mitigation (e.g. Section 4.5.2, Section 4.6) summarise other studies' results (Chen et al. 2021, Tetila et al. 2017, etc.) and so do not count as the study's own evidence. Q1 is 'no', hence Q2-Q9 are 'no'.

notes: Study is a secondary source (systematic literature review); full text appears complete including appendix and references.
